constraints.source_text: The only prerequisite for this minor is one semester of elementary calculus.
constraints.description: Students must have completed one semester of elementary calculus before entering the minor.
constraints.note: No explicit EMPHASIS_ENTRY category for minors in taxonomy; closest fit.

constraints.source_text: As with all minors, students must include at least four upper-division courses
constraints.description: At least four of the courses used for the minor must be upper-division.

constraints.source_text: and four courses dedicated exclusively to this minor (which may be the same four courses).
constraints.description: At least four courses used for the minor must not count toward any other requirement (major, etc.), though they may overlap with the upper-division requirement.
constraints.note: Text bundles two conditions; split into distribution and reuse records.

constraints.source_text: Finally, students must select four courses outside their major department.
constraints.description: At least four courses in the minor must be outside the student's major department.

constraints.source_text: These may be the same four courses used to meet the first two conditions.
constraints.description: The four courses satisfying the outside-department requirement may be the same courses used for the upper-division and exclusivity requirements.

details.scope: upper-division requirement, exclusivity requirement, outside-major requirement

constraints.source_text: Note that Math BA and BS economics/mathematics students may complete this minor by taking MATH 407 and MATH 408 and at least 16 additional upper-division units approved by the Department of Mathematics, which are not in their major department and not being used to satisfy a requirement for their major.
constraints.description: Math BA and BS economics/mathematics students follow an alternate path for the minor requiring specific and adviser-approved courses.

details.applies_to: Math BA and BS economics/mathematics students
details.effect: must take MATH 407, MATH 408, and at least 16 additional upper-division units approved by the Department of Mathematics, outside major department and not used for major

constraints.source_text: MATH 307 Statistical Inference and Data Analysis I Units: 4 (prerequisite: MATH 118 or MATH 125 ) and MATH 308 Statistical Inference and Data Analysis II Units: 4 or MATH 407 Probability Theory Units: 4 and MATH 408 Mathematical Statistics Units: 4
constraints.description: Students must complete either the MATH 307/308 sequence or the MATH 407/408 sequence as required courses.

constraints.source_text: Select 8 units from the following: BME 210 Biomedical Computer Simulation Methods Units: 4, BME 423 Statistical and Data Science Methods in Biomedical Engineering Units: 4, BUAD 311 Operations Management Units: 4 *, DSO 424 Business Forecasting Units: 4 *, DSO 427 Spreadsheet Modeling for Business Insights Units: 4, ECON 318 Introduction to Econometrics Units: 4, ECON 419 Advanced Econometrics Units: 4, HP 350L Health Behavior Research Methods Units: 4, ISE 426 Statistical Process Control and Analytics Units: 4, MATH 447 Mathematics of Machine Learning Units: 4, PM 522a Introduction to the Theory of Statistics Units: 3, PM 522b Introduction to the Theory of Statistics Units: 3, PPD 504 Essential Statistics for Public Management Units: 2, PSYC 421L Data Analysis for Psychological Research Units: 4, QBIO 478 Computational Genome Analysis Units: 4
constraints.description: Students must select 8 units of electives from a specified list of courses.

constraints.source_text: Any upper-division or graduate level class not appearing in the above list that involves the theory or application of statistics may be approved by the Department of Mathematics as an elective.
constraints.description: Courses not on the elective list may be approved individually by the Department of Mathematics to count as electives.

unclassified.source_text: Note also that if calculus must be taken to satisfy the prerequisite for MATH 307 , 20 units would be required to complete the minor.
unclassified.why: This is a conditional statement about total units depending on whether calculus must be taken, not a clean filter-measure-bound rule or any other taxonomy family.
